notes.title: 🌎 Around the World 5: Beautiful America Collector's Edition — out today!
notes.notes:
[p]The new chapter of the [i]Around the World[/i] series is here! Embark on an unforgettable journey across the most picturesque corners of the USA — from majestic canyons and national parks to bustling metropolises and cozy coastal towns.[/p][p]This is more than just a hidden object game — it’s a true virtual adventure:
🔎 Over 30 colorful, detailed locations filled with atmosphere.
🧩 Engaging mini-games and logical puzzles.
🎶 Relaxing music and a leisurely pace — play at your own speed.
🎁 Souvenirs and collectibles to preserve your travel memories.[/p][p][b]Collector’s Edition makes the journey even brighter:[/b]
✨ Unique bonus scenes and quests.
✨ Exclusive mini-games for true genre lovers.
✨ Save your favorite landscapes as wallpapers in your personal gallery.[/p][p]Dive into the beauty of America, escape the rush, and enjoy a journey without leaving home!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3609910/Around_the_World_5_Beautiful_America_Collectors_Edition/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]
